title: Secure account sign-in
description: Allow a registered user to sign in and return to their authorized workspace.
user_goal: Sign in securely without repeating steps.
business_value: Access the correct workspace while protecting account data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered user; when valid credentials are accepted; then an authenticated session is created and only authorized workspaces are shown. Given invalid credentials; when sign-in fails; then the user receives a clear error without revealing account existence.
dependencies: OIDC provider; session service; workspace authorization
non_functional_requirements: WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard operable; visible focus; no credential values in logs; p95 sign-in completion under 3 seconds.
out_of_scope: Password reset; account registration; identity-provider administration.
success_metric: Successful sign-in rate; failed sign-in error clarity; unauthorized-workspace access rate equals zero.

title: Export saved report as CSV
description: Allow an authorized workspace member to download a CSV export of a saved report.
user_goal: Export report results for offline analysis.
business_value: Reduce manual copying while retaining an auditable export record.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized member and a saved report; when the member requests CSV export; then a UTF-8 CSV is downloaded with the report columns and an audit event is retained. Given a member without report access; when export is requested; then no data is returned.
dependencies: Report query API; audit ledger; file delivery
non_functional_requirements: WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard operable; authorization checked server-side; CSV injection protected; p95 export initiation under 2 seconds for a standard report.
out_of_scope: Scheduled reports; PDF export; sharing reports outside the workspace.
success_metric: Successful authorized exports; denied unauthorized exports; export completion time.

title: Workspace notification preferences
description: Allow a workspace member to choose which non-critical product notifications they receive.
business_value: Improve relevance and reduce avoidable notification volume.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated member; when notification preferences are saved; then the new preferences are shown on refresh and subsequent eligible notifications follow them. Given an invalid channel selection; when save is attempted; then no preference is changed and a clear validation message is shown.
dependencies: Notification service; preference store; email provider
non_functional_requirements: WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard operable; explicit labels; preference changes are auditable; p95 save under 1 second.
out_of_scope: Marketing consent management; SMS provider onboarding; organization-wide policy settings.
success_metric: Preference-save success rate; notification opt-out rate; duplicate notification rate.
